items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: who was it, Leonard Feather? He said poor Marian has got three strikes against her before she even starts being a jazz musician.

ctx.x: You've got to come back to that basic beat, that rhythm is your thing, is the thing. Because you have all your harmonies and everything else.

So she just kept doing it and that's a girl that really did it. And I'm telling you, you know, I don't know how because, who was it, Leonard Feather? He said poor Marian has got three strikes against her before she even starts being a jazz musician. And that is she's British, she's white...
